Display Name: Portland cement shipments (Texas, then U.S. portland-only)
Description: Portland cement shipments: Texas (USGS Mineral Industry Surveys) through 2023-12; from 2024-01 the U.S. portland-only all-destination total (USGS Mineral Industry Surveys Table 2a) (monthly, metric tons)
Series ID: Data Master 'Mat - Portland Cment Shipmts' (snapshot USGS_CEMENT; release calendar USGS_CEMENT_MIS)
Transformation: Monthly level; only growth transforms are traded
Known Quirks: Coverage change at 2024-01 (Texas total -> U.S. portland-only Table 2a total; the 2024 year-over-year growth rates are an artifact of it); portland-only excludes blended cement (Type IL); no archive of first-published values (value_vintage revised_no_archive); published about 2-5 months after the month; Data Master ends 2025-06
Display Note: Construction-activity indicator; the trending level is never a signal.
